titulo: Your site: a product page with cARCKHÉtic scroll, published
lead: Time to put it all together on a page of your own. You start from the kit's template, swap the photo and the text for those of your product, redo the two films, pass the four-check gate and publish to GitHub Pages. The same checker that ran on your machine runs against the public URL: it is what says you are live.

blocos.rot: Terminal · build the page and pass the gate
blocos.conteudo:
K=~/projetos/formacao-cARCKHÉ-ia-sites-v72/kit
E=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/ensaio-sites/a8; rm -rf "$E"; mkdir -p "$E"
# your site starts as a copy of the template; swap the product photo for yours (here: the lens lying down)
cp -r "$K/site" "$E/meu-site"; rm -f "$E/meu-site"/erro-*.html
bash "$K/scripts/clipe.sh" "$K/exemplos/lente2.jpg" "$E/h.mp4" 6 1.0 1.3
bash "$K/scripts/clipe.sh" "$K/exemplos/lente2.jpg" "$E/v.mp4" 6 1.0 1.3 1080x1920
bash "$K/scripts/quadros.sh" "$E/h.mp4" "$E/meu-site/frames" 1024 6
bash "$K/scripts/quadros.sh" "$E/v.mp4" "$E/meu-site/frames-v" 600 8
bash "$K/scripts/portao.sh" "$E/meu-site"; echo "saída: $?"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# portao.sh — o portão final da página: 4 conferências, uma por vez, sem modelo e sem serviço pago.
#   1. peso       visitante mais pesado ≤ ORCAMENTO MB (padrão 6) e primeira pintura ≤ 0,5 MB
#   2. computador 1366×768: rolagem em 0 %, 50 % e 100 % com o quadro certo e tela pintada
#   3. celular    390×844 em pé: filme vertical (frames-v/), sem transbordo
#   4. reduzir    com "reduzir movimento": o filme fica parado
# Uso: bash portao.sh <pasta-do-site>          (ORCAMENTO=8 bash portao.sh … muda o teto)
set -uo pipefail
K=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
SITE=$(cd "$1" && pwd)
T=$(mktemp -d); trap 'kill $S 2>/dev/null; rm -rf "$T"' EXIT
node "$K/scripts/servir.mjs" "$SITE" > "$T/url" & S=$!
until U=$(cat "$T/url" 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$U" ] && curl -s -o /dev/null "$U"; do sleep 0.3; done
ok=0
python3 "$K/scripts/peso.py" "$SITE" --orcamento "${ORCAMENTO:-6}" --inicial 0.5 > "$T/1" && ok=$((ok+1)) && echo "1 peso: OK" || { echo "1 peso: FALHA"; grep -E "ACIMA" "$T/1"; }
for n in "2 computador:" "3 celular:--celular" "4 reduzir:--reduzir"; do
  rot=${n%%:*}; op=${n#*:}
  node "$K/scripts/verificar.mjs" "$U" $op > "$T/v" && ok=$((ok+1)) && echo "$rot: OK" || { echo "$rot: FALHA"; grep "^FALHA" "$T/v"; }
done
echo "PORTÃO: $ok/4 $([ $ok -eq 4 ] && echo OK || echo FALHOU)"
[ $ok -eq 4 ]

degraus.titulo: Lesson 1 · When the weight is worth it

txt.travou: ## What got stuck and the rule I created

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after you answer.

perguntas.p: portao.sh returned "PORTÃO: 3/4 FALHOU" with "1 peso: FALHA". What do you do first?
opcoes: Publish anyway and fix the weight after the page is live.
Raise the ORCAMENTO until it passes.
See which visitor went over the limit and redo that visitor's frames lighter.
perguntas.explica: The gate tells you which check failed, and the line ABOVE tells you what is heavy. Raising the limit hides the problem; deleting the vertical makes the phone worse.

perguntas.p: Why run the checker against the public URL too?
opcoes: Because once it is live, the file paths, the repository folder and the server are different, and only a test there proves the page works for whoever visits.
Because the local checker does not open canvas.
Because the public URL is faster.
perguntas.explica: A frame with the wrong name on the server, a folder that did not upload, an absolute path: all of that passes locally and breaks live. The same checker, a different URL.

perguntas.p: What text goes in your page's index.html?
opcoes: The film script, to explain what the camera does.
A customer testimonial written by you, to build trust with visitors.
Only short facts about your product that say what the image does not.
perguntas.explica: The copy gate rejects camera scripts; an invented testimonial and a number without a source do not go anywhere. The text sells with what is true.

perguntas.p: Which of these is NOT one of the four checks in portao.sh?
perguntas.explica: The four are weight, desktop, mobile, and reduced motion. Core Web Vitals belongs to the ARCKHÉSEO Formation.
